title: Grade 5 · Decimal multiplication · 03 · Area and place value
description: Build area models and connect decimal products to partial products. Draw models for the first four questions. Original TEKS-based home practice; not an official Coppell ISD assessment. Each question is worth 10 points.
subject: math

prompt.text: Draw a hundredths-grid area model for 0.2 × 0.7. Label both side lengths and the overlapping area. Write the product.

criteria.label: Area model
criteria.description: Draws a rectangle with dimensions 0.2 and 0.7, labels the side lengths, and partitions or shades it consistently with decimal place value. A correctly labeled partial-products area model is acceptable.

criteria.label: Product
criteria.description: Writes the correct product 0.14 and connects it to the model. Equivalent trailing zeros are acceptable.

answer.sampleAnswer: A rectangle labeled 0.2 by 0.7, partitioned by ones and tenths or shown on a hundredths grid, with the shaded/combined area labeled 0.14.

steps: Draw and label a rectangle with side lengths 0.2 and 0.7.
Partition the sides by place value or use a hundredths grid. Label the partial areas and combine them.
The total area is 0.14 square units.
